newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: IHC expects to land big Chinese order soon.
newsitem.headline: IHC expects to land big Chinese order soon.

text.p: Shipbuilding and engineering group IHC Caland NV said on Monday it expected to clinch a Chinese order worth several hundred million guilders within the next six months.

"The memorandum of understanding signed with the (Chinese) Ministry of Water Resources has since been followed by a letter of intent and we expect a contract within six months or so," chairman Jan Bax told a news conference on first-half results.
Earlier the company reported 1996 first-half net profit fell to 34.9 million guilders from 36.6 million in the year-earlier period.

The company has forecast a 21 percent jump in full-year net profit to no less than 91 million guilders or 3.63 guilders per share, as the majority of orders scheduled for delivery in 1996 will be completed in the second half.

The Chinese order for the local construction of 100 small and medium-sized Beaver series cutter suction dredgers was worth "several hundreds of millions of guilders over the next five years," Bax said.
He said the company booked new orders worth 745 million guilders in the first half of 1996, bringing the total order book to 3.4 billion guilders as per June 30, 1996.
This figure included future lease income on floating production and storage systems (FPSOs), he added.
